title: Binance Soft Staking Activation via Spot Account Now Available
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance users can now activate  Soft Staking  directly  via   their  Spot Account . Upon  activation , users who hold the required minimum amount of eligible tokens in their Spot Account can start earning staking rewards directly to their Spot Account. Note : Please update your Binance app to version 3.1.0 or later to access this feature. How to Activate Soft Staking via Spot Account: If a user’s Spot assets  meet the minimum required amount  for any eligible token, a  grey [Soft Staking] tag  will be displayed next to the token with the highest qualifying balance. Once activated, the tag will turn  yellow .  Website Step 1: Go to [Profile] > [Assets] >  [ Spot ] . Step 2: Click the grey  [Soft Staking]  tag next to an eligible token, only applicable to users who meet the minimum holding requirements for Soft Staking tokens. Step 3: Read and agree to the terms and click  [Start Earning] . App Step 1: Tap on [Assets] on the App homepage. Step 2: Go to  [Spot] . Step 3: Tap the grey  [Soft Staking]  Tag next to the eligible tokens, only applicable to users who meet the minimum holding requirements for Soft Staking tokens.  Step 4: Read and agree to the terms and click  [Start Earning] . About Soft Staking  Launched in June 2025,  Soft Staking  lets you earn staking rewards on selected tokens directly from your Spot Account — no lock-up, no redemption needed. Just activate it with one click and start earning, while keeping full control of your tokens. Current supported tokens:  BNB, SOL, ADA, SUI, TON, NEAR, POL, ALGO, S, AXS . Each token has a minimum holding requirement and reward cap. For more details, visit the  Soft Staking page . Why Use Binance Soft Staking? Full Flexibility : No lockup periods required. Withdraw or Trade Anytime:  Access and use your assets anytime without restrictions. Daily Rewards:  Receive daily staking rewards directly credited to your Spot Account. Activate Soft Staking Now For More Information: Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Soft Staking Binance Introduces Soft Staking: Earn Staking Rewards from Your Spot Assets with Full Flexibility Notes: Please refer to  Binance Soft Staking Terms ,  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Risk Warning  prior to using Binance Soft Staking. Users can view their soft staking amount and staking rewards by going to the  Soft Staking  page. Average daily snapshots of the Spot Account will start at 00:00 (UTC) on the day after the user activates Soft Staking. Staking rewards will be distributed to eligible users’ Spot Accounts on the next day after the snapshot (the second day after activation), between 00:00 and 08:00 (UTC).  Soft Staking may not be available to certain users depending on the user’s jurisdiction. U.S. persons, entities, and individuals from sanctioned countries will  not  be able to use Binance Soft Staking. Additionally, users may face access restrictions to Soft Staking due to prevailing product and/or regulatory limitations. For more information, please refer to  Binance Terms of Use . Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Disclaimer : By subscribing your Spot Account to Soft Staking, you acknowledge that the Eligible Soft Staked assets are no longer held in your Spot Account. Digital assets deployed in on-chain staking are subject to various risks. Binance's ability to return your Soft Staked Assets promptly may be adversely affected or delayed if a substantial number of Soft Staking Assets are withdrawn simultaneously, and the quantity of assets locked on-chain exceeds the available liquidity managed by Binance. There is no guaranteed timeframe for completing redemption or conversion requests. The Staking Rate is subject to change and may fluctuate from the rate applicable at the time of subscription. Digital asset prices can be volatile. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions, and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is an estimate of rewards you will earn in cryptocurrency over the selected timeframe. It does not represent actual or predicted returns/yield in any fiat currency. APR is adjusted daily, and estimated rewards may differ from actual rewards generated. This is not financial advice. For more information, please see our  Terms of Use  and  Risk Warning .
